about: Sourced kit numbers the audit (briefs/specs/kit-audit) marks as matching the source. --kit-parity-check fails when content/archetypes/<hero>.json (or the content file a field names, weapons/quill_rifle:primary.dmg) drifts outside tolerance. How to add a row: docs/ARCHETYPES.md, 'Kit parity lock'.
